measurements.subject: the holy district set apart for the LORD, breadth
measurements.notes: ESV follows the Septuagint ('20,000'); the Hebrew reads 10,000 in all three places (ESV footnotes at 45:1, 48:9 ['Compare 45:1'], and 48:13). With 10,000 the district is the priests' strip alone (48:10); with 20,000 it is the priests' + Levites' strips together (48:10-13), which 48:20's 25,000-square total (20,000 + the 5,000 city strip) supports. Both readings preserved; rendered per the ESV as printed.

measurements.subject: the holy district set apart for the LORD, length
measurements.notes: The ESV's measure footnote at 45:1/48:8 glosses both the common and the long cubit; recorded as the long cubit per the vision's own declared standard (Ezek 40:5), the convention used across the Ezekiel 40-48 dataset.
